question: Should OpenClaw reserve the top-level `auth` CLI root despite its ability to shadow plugin CLI commands, or keep model authentication exclusively under `models auth`?
rationale: This choice changes both the public CLI contract and the plugin command namespace, so automation cannot decide whether the compatibility cost is acceptable.

options.title: Keep models-only
options.body: Reject the new root and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the single collision-free canonical surface.

options.title: Design collision-safe auth root
options.body: Pause this PR and first define an approved namespace or migration contract that cannot silently displace plugin commands.

options.title: Accept root reservation
options.body: Explicitly reserve `auth`, document the plugin compatibility impact, and require upgrade and live-command proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Keep models-only
recommendation.body: Reject the new root and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the single collision-free canonical surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work explicitly established the model-provider auth listing boundary under `models auth`.
